blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel has decided, for now, that they will not call Vice President Sara Duterte to the witness stand for her own impeachment trial as the documents she signed and swore to have spoken loudly enough. In a press briefing on Monday, after a break during the trial before the Senate Impeachment Court, counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. said the declarations of the vice president were presented as evidence — referring to the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN), Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) tax documents, and bank records.
